events.title: Mongols destroy the Hungarian army at Mohi
events.description: Mongol forces under Batu and Subutai encircled and annihilated King Béla IV's army by the Sajó river. Hungary was laid open to a year of devastating occupation.
events.html: Mongol forces under Batu and Subutai encircled and annihilated King Béla IV's army by the Sajó river. Hungary was laid open to a year of devastating occupation.

events.title: William III and Mary II are crowned joint monarchs
events.description: William and Mary were crowned together in Westminster Abbey after accepting the Declaration of Rights. The settlement confirmed the Glorious Revolution and the limits Parliament had placed on the Crown.
events.html: William and Mary were crowned together in Westminster Abbey after accepting the Declaration of Rights. The settlement confirmed the Glorious Revolution and the limits Parliament had placed on the Crown.

events.title: Treaty of Fontainebleau sends Napoleon to Elba
events.description: The allied powers signed the treaty confirming Napoleon's abdication and granting him the island of Elba as a sovereign principality. He escaped less than a year later for the Hundred Days.
events.html: The allied powers signed the treaty confirming Napoleon's abdication and granting him the island of Elba as a sovereign principality. He escaped less than a year later for the Hundred Days.

events.title: US troops reach Buchenwald concentration camp
events.description: American soldiers arrived at Buchenwald near Weimar, where prisoners had already taken control of the camp. Some 56,000 people had died there; Eisenhower later had local Germans brought to see it.
events.html: American soldiers arrived at Buchenwald near Weimar, where prisoners had already taken control of the camp. Some 56,000 people had died there; Eisenhower later had local Germans brought to see it.

events.title: Adolf Eichmann's trial opens in Jerusalem
events.description: Adolf Eichmann, a principal organiser of the deportation of Europe's Jews, went on trial in Jerusalem. Survivor testimony broadcast worldwide shaped public understanding of the Holocaust; he was hanged in 1962.
events.html: Adolf Eichmann, a principal organiser of the deportation of Europe's Jews, went on trial in Jerusalem. Survivor testimony broadcast worldwide shaped public understanding of the Holocaust; he was hanged in 1962.

events.title: Apollo 13 lifts off for the Moon
events.description: Apollo 13 launched from Kennedy Space Center. Two days out an oxygen tank exploded, the lunar landing was abandoned, and the crew used the lunar module as a lifeboat to return safely.
events.html: Apollo 13 launched from Kennedy Space Center. Two days out an oxygen tank exploded, the lunar landing was abandoned, and the crew used the lunar module as a lifeboat to return safely.
